citations.title: Oregon Legislative Revenue Office, 2016 Oregon Public Finance: Basic Facts (Research Report #1-16)
citations.quote: In addition to being one of five states without a general sales tax, Oregon ranks 32nd in selective sales tax collections per person.

notes: Oregon has no general state or local sales tax. 2016-01-01 is the start of the year of the Legislative Revenue Office's 2016 Basic Facts report, the earliest dated official statement read here; Oregon has never had a general sales tax, so the treatment is much older. The DOR page is undated (it was revised after June 2018). Oregon's vehicle use tax on new vehicles bought out of state and the Corporate Activity Tax (a tax on the business's gross receipts, not collected from buyers) are not sales taxes and are not modelled. Some Oregon school districts levy a construction excise tax on new construction, paid when a building permit is issued; it is not a sales tax and was not verified here.
